name: Moroccan Halloumi, Apricot & Shallot Sauté with Carrot-Arugula Salad

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the arugula if it came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
1 (1 inch) piece ginger root
½ lemon
3 apricots
1 medium carrot
½ small pkg fresh mint
½ (5 oz) pkg baby arugula

instructions.primary_message: Peel and mince ginger. Place in a small bowl, along with spices, then stir to combine the spice mix.
instructions.secondary_message:
cumin, ground
salt
black pepper
coriander, ground
cinnamon, ground
⅛ tsp cloves, ground

instructions.primary_message: Juice lemon into a medium bowl. Add half of the spice mix (reserving remainder for the halloumi), oil, and maple syrup, then whisk to combine the marinade.
instructions.secondary_message:
extra virgin olive oil
pure maple syrup

instructions.primary_message: Peel and quarter shallot lengthwise. Add to the bowl with the marinade.
Halve apricots lengthwise (around the pit); twist halves to separate, then remove and discard pits. Cut each half into ¼-inch thick slices, add to the bowl, and toss to combine. Set aside.
Preheat a skillet over medium heat.

While the skillet heats up, pat halloumi dry with paper towels; holding a knife parallel to the cutting board, cut the halloumi in half horizontally, then cut each half lengthwise into 1-inch thick strips. Season both sides with the reserved spice mix.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add the halloumi and cook, turning halfway through, until golden brown on both sides, 5-6 minutes. Remove to a plate and cover with aluminum foil to keep warm. (Reserve skillet for later use and bowl for the next step.)
Meanwhile, place oil, vinegar, maple syrup, and spices in another medium bowl. Whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
extra virgin olive oil
1 tsp red wine vinegar
pure maple syrup
salt
black pepper
cumin, ground
coriander, ground
cinnamon, ground

instructions.primary_message: Peel, trim, and coarsely grate carrot. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Pick mint leaves off the stems; discard stems and roughly chop the leaves. Add to the bowl, along with the arugula, and toss to combine the salad. Set aside.

Return the skillet to medium-high heat. Add apricots and shallots; cook, stirring occasionally, until tender and caramelized, 2-3 minutes. Return halloumi to the skillet, stir to combine, and remove from heat.
To serve, divide salad and halloumi sauté between plates or bowls. Enjoy!
